findings.action: Handle UnicodeDecodeError consistently when building source_text and add a wired regression test containing a non-UTF-8 candidate module to prove the recommendation/probe completes.
evidence: tests_referencing_paths reads every candidate test and mutation-pool module with read_text(encoding="utf-8") but catches only OSError.
UnicodeDecodeError is not an OSError, so one non-UTF-8 candidate aborts the mapper instead of being skipped.
_local_loader_ancestor_levels explicitly catches (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) and documents native/repograph/fixtures/non_utf8.py as a known non-UTF-8 fixture.
The new _candidate_module_sources contract expands scanning to the mutation pool, but the supplied tests cover OSError reads only and do not exercise a non-UTF-8 candidate source.
findings.summary: The expanded mutation-pool source scan does not tolerate UnicodeDecodeError, despite the same file documenting a known non-UTF-8 repository fixture.

next_move: Repair and test the mutation scanner's non-UTF-8 boundary, then produce exact-head focused and release-quality evidence for the 8.7.1 candidate and rerun the bounded critique.
